content:
The model successfully implemented a multi-phase Excel manipulation task using openpyxl to map source data to calculation blocks via dynamic formulas.
The model utilized a 2D lookup pattern using INDEX and MATCH to map series codes and years across sheets. Formulas were correctly injected as strings to maintain dynamic calculations for 'Latency Budget Preserved', 'Consumed', and 'Capacity' blocks. Validation confirmed that spatial layouts (rows 12-31 to 35-50) and existing sheet formatting were preserved throughout the execution.
